sentences.text:
Daku vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 April, 2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:8770
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh

On The 2 nd Of April, 2026
 Criminal Appeal No. 1434 of 2016
 Daku And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Ms. Surbhi Bahal -Advocate for the appellants.
 Shri Rajendra Singh Suryawanshi- Ga for the State.
 Order

This criminal appeal under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred being
aggrieved by order judgment dated 03.10.2016 in Special St No.12/2015 by the Special Sessions
Judge, S

whereby appellants- Daku and Suresh have been convicted under sections 376(1) of the IPC read with section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, 2012 sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.10,000/- and under section 506 (part-II) of the IPC sentenced to undergo RI for 2 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- for each appellants with default stipulations.

2. The appellants were prosecuted, convicted and sentenced in a case arising out of crime No.359/2015 registered at police station- Ranapur, District- Jhabua (M.P.)
3.

The PUD No.289/Warrant/2026 Jhabua, dated 26.03.2026 received from Superintendent of Jail,
District Jail Jhabua (M.P.) mentions NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8770 2 CRA-1434-2016 that appellants- Daku S/o Bhurchand has been released from jail after completing the jail sentence on 18.03.2023 and appellant Suresh S/o- Juwansingh has been relased from jail after completing the jail sentence on 20.11.2023 4.

Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellants/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
